name: mindie-agent
description: Ascend NPU & vLLM-Ascend engineering assistant: complete MCP suite for remote NPU development, profiling, roofline simulation, CANN/ACLGraph debugging, NPU fleet monitoring, cluster lease coordination, and L1-L4 graded knowledge flywheel.

display.name: MindIE Agent
display.description_zh: 昇腾 NPU 与 vLLM-Ascend 全栈研发连接器与插件：完整暴露远端 NPU 容器开发 (remote-dev 20 项工具)、性能采集剖析 (profiler)、Roofline 与拓扑仿真 (sim)、CANN 故障与 ACLGraph/精度调试 (debugger)、集群算力实时监控 (npu-top)、NPU/端口租约队列协调 (coordinator) 及 L1-L4 分级知识飞轮 (knowledge)。
display.description_en: Full-stack Ascend NPU & vLLM-Ascend engineering plugin and connector: exposes 40 MCP tools across remote NPU development (remote-dev), profiling (profiler), Roofline/topology simulation (sim), CANN/ACLGraph/precision debugging (debugger), NPU fleet telemetry (npu-top), NPU/port lease coordination (coordinator), and L1-L4 graded knowledge retrieval/distillation (knowledge).
examples_zh: /mindie-agent 排查 vLLM-Ascend 新模型 0-day Bring-up 精度偏差与 ACLGraph 捕获同步违规
查看昇腾集群各节点空闲 NPU 卡与显存状态，并申请双 Die 同 Package 测试租约
分析远端容器中的昇腾 A3 910C Profiling 算子耗时瓶颈并运行 Roofline 仿真评估
对远端 NPU 容器中的报错日志执行 CANN 错误码解码与多卡故障根因归因 (debugger)
examples_en: /mindie-agent Investigate 0-day vLLM-Ascend model bring-up precision drift and ACLGraph capture violations
Check observed idle NPUs across the Ascend cluster and acquire a same-package NPU lease via coordinator
Analyze Ascend A3 910C profiling traces and run Roofline simulation for operator bottlenecks
Triage multi-rank CANN plog faults and decode RTS/HCCL error codes with mindie-debugger
